course.learn: This section focuses on **Architectural Considerations** within **Architectural Considerations**. Architectural decisions balance availability, resilience, cost, responsiveness, scalability, deployment complexity, recovery, patchability, power, and compute capacity. There is rarely one universally best design.
course.why: Security architecture must meet business requirements as well as technical security goals.
course.example: A highly available design adds redundant regions and automated failover, but the organization accepts higher cost and operational complexity.
course.exam: When several answers are technically secure, choose the design that best satisfies the stated business constraint and failure scenario.
